title: Other Ways to Say "Good Luck" in English #shorts
description:
Other ways to say "Good luck" in English. Don't say "Good luck". Say this instead:
• Best of luck. (polite)
• Break a leg. (before a show)
• Fingers crossed. (hopeful)
• You've got this. (encouraging)
• I'm rooting for you. (supportive)

Which one will you try today? Write it in the comments.
